description: This Java class 'ShipmentServices' provides various static service methods related to shipment operations in the OFBiz framework, including creating and removing shipment estimates, calculating shipment costs, updating shipment staging tables, processing shipment receipts, duplicating shipment route segments, and sending shipment notifications.

classes.name: ShipmentServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for shipment-related services in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createShipmentEstimate
methods.description: Creates a shipment cost estimate based on provided parameters and applies quantity breaks.

methods.name: removeShipmentEstimate
methods.description: Removes a shipment cost estimate identified by its ID.

methods.name: applyQuantityBreak
methods.description: Helper method to apply quantity break logic to shipment estimates.

methods.name: calcShipmentCostEstimate
methods.description: Calculates the total shipment cost estimate based on various parameters and estimates.

methods.name: resolveShippingAddress
methods.description: Resolves the shipping address based on contact mech ID or postal code and country.

methods.name: matchGeoAndBreakQuantity
methods.description: Checks if the shipping address matches geographic and quantity break criteria.

methods.name: isBreakQuantityValid
methods.description: Validates if a quantity falls within a specified break range.

methods.name: fillShipmentStagingTables
methods.description: Fills staging tables with shipment data for external processing.

methods.name: updateShipmentsFromStaging
methods.description: Updates shipment records from staging data, including shipment packages and route segments.

methods.name: clearShipmentStagingInfo
methods.description: Clears staging data related to a shipment.

methods.name: updatePurchaseShipmentFromReceipt
methods.description: Updates shipment status based on receipt data, marking as received if all items match.

methods.name: duplicateShipmentRouteSegment
methods.description: Duplicates a shipment route segment with optional modifications.

methods.name: quickScheduleShipmentRouteSegment
methods.description: Asynchronously confirms shipment via carrier-specific logic, e.g., DHL.

methods.name: getShipmentPackageValueFromOrders
methods.description: Calculates total value of a shipment package by summing invoiced amounts prorated by issued quantities.

methods.name: sendShipmentCompleteNotification
methods.description: Sends an email notification upon shipment completion.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigFromShipment
methods.description: Retrieves shipment gateway configuration details based on shipment data.
